word-water.def: the clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers, lakes and seas

word-eat.def: to put food in your mouth, chew it and swallow it

word-drink.def: to take a liquid into your mouth and swallow it

word-big.def: of more than average size or amount

word-small.def: of less than average size or amount

word-brother-older.def: a male sibling who was born before you

word-brother-younger.def: a male sibling who was born after you

word-hand.def: the part of the body at the end of the arm, with a palm and five fingers

word-arm.def: the long part of the body between the shoulder and the hand

word-monday.def: the day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday

word-tuesday.def: the day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday

phrase-thank-you.def: what you say to show you are grateful for something
